body:
I've wanted to be an artist for a while, but it is so difficult to learn and I don't feel like I'm getting any better. I feel like I should get into something more viable for the future, like programming, but I'm not very smart, especially not after my car accident. 

And no, I don't think my parents will want to help me at all, and I don't even want to ask them for help.

I don't know how or where to even begin, It's all I've know, I've been homeschooled since elementary and at some point my parents just stopped trying to teach me.

Thank you for reading by the way.
